function: Internal auditory/labyrinthine artery usually arises from AICA, occasionally directly from the basilar artery. It travels with CN VII/VIII through the internal acoustic meatus to supply the inner ear and associated nerve structures. It does not supply the brainstem cochlear or vestibular nuclei.

It gives variable medullary, tonsillar and choroidal branches; fourth-ventricular plexus is distinct from lateral-ventricular plexus.
